ThunderBirdX @VERSION@, a modern, free email app built on Thunderbird @BASE@.

**What's new:** see the [changelog](https://github.com/QuantumBoy-729/ThunderBirdX/blob/overhaul/.github/CHANGELOG.md). For everything ThunderBirdX can do, see the [feature list](https://github.com/QuantumBoy-729/ThunderBirdX#features).

## Download

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows 10 and 11 (installer) | `ThunderBirdX-@VERSION@-windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| Windows (portable zip) | `ThunderBirdX-@VERSION@-windows-x64.zip` |
| macOS (Apple silicon) | `ThunderBirdX-@VERSION@-macos-arm64.dmg` |
| Linux (64-bit) | `ThunderBirdX-@VERSION@-linux-x64.tar.xz` |

`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the checksum of every file.

## Before you install

- **Not code signed yet.** On Windows, if SmartScreen warns you, choose
  *More info → Run anyway*. On macOS, drag ThunderBirdX to Applications, then
  right-click it and choose *Open* the first time. If macOS says the app is
  damaged, run `xattr -cr /Applications/ThunderBirdX.app` in Terminal.
- **Updates:** ThunderBirdX checks for new versions once a day and tells you
  when one is out; you download and install it yourself. You can turn this off
  in *Settings → Appearance → ThunderBirdX → Updates*.
- **Already use Thunderbird?** ThunderBirdX starts with its own profile and
  leaves your Thunderbird setup alone. To bring your mail over, use
  *Tools → Import* in the app menu. See
  [Coming from Thunderbird](https://github.com/QuantumBoy-729/ThunderBirdX#coming-from-thunderbird).
- On Windows, the program file and its shortcuts still show the Thunderbird
  Daily icon; the app itself uses the ThunderBirdX logo.
